name: LUFFY
hints: Ate a Devil Fruit that turned his body to rubber.
Captain of a pirate crew aiming to be King of the Pirates.
Wears an iconic straw hat given to him by Shanks.

name: EREN
hints: Possesses the power of the Attack and Founding Titans.
Swore to wipe out every single Titan after losing his mother.
Grew up inside Wall Maria in the Shiganshina District.

name: REM
hints: Wields a spiked morningstar flail and has a single white horn.
Has blue hair and is fiercely devoted to Subaru.
Works as a maid at a mansion alongside her twin sister.

name: SPIKE
hints: Has a cybernetic right eye and a fluffy dark green afro.
Practices Jeet Kune Do and pilots a red Swordfish II fighter.
A laid-back bounty hunter cruising space aboard the Bebop.

name: ASUNA
hints: Served as sub-leader of the Knights of the Blood Oath guild.
Known as 'The Flash' for her blinding rapier speed.
Fell in love with Kirito while trapped on Aincrad.

name: DENJI
hints: Pulls a starter cord on his chest to transform.
Joined Public Safety Division 4 mostly for good food.
Worked off his father's yakuza debt by hunting devils with Pochita.

name: GOKU
hints: Sent to Earth as an infant to destroy it, but bumped his head.
Uses the Kamehameha and goes Super Saiyan.
Constantly seeks stronger opponents to fight.

name: NARUTO
hints: Has the Nine-Tailed Fox sealed inside him.
Always yells 'Believe it!' and dreams of becoming Hokage.
Loves eating Ichiraku Ramen and wears an orange jumpsuit.

name: SUBARU
hints: Possesses 'Return by Death', rewinding time whenever he dies.
Wears an iconic black-and-orange tracksuit.
Was suddenly transported to another world outside a convenience store.

name: RUDEUS
hints: Earned the nickname 'Quagmire' during his time as an adventurer.
Trained in water magic by Roxy Migurdia as a child.
Reincarnated into a fantasy world while keeping his past-life memories.

name: SATORU
hints: Uses the Limitless technique and Domain Expansion: Infinite Void.
Considered the strongest jujutsu sorcerer alive.
Covers his bright blue Six Eyes with a blindfold or sunglasses.

name: EDWARD
hints: Can perform alchemy without drawing a transmutation circle.
Gets furious whenever anyone calls him short.
Lost his right arm and left leg in a failed human transmutation.

name: KILLUA
hints: Transmutes his aura into deadly electricity.
Ran away from his famous family of elite assassins.
Best friends with Gon Freecss and loves chocolate robots.

name: TANJIRO
hints: Uses Water & Sun Breathing.
Possesses an extraordinarily sharp sense of smell.
Carries his demon sister inside a wooden box on his back.

name: LELOUCH
hints: Commands absolute obedience from anyone who makes eye contact with his left eye.
Leads the Black Knights under the masked identity 'Zero'.
An exiled Britannian prince attending Ashford Academy.

name: THORFINN
hints: Son of the legendary Jomsviking warrior Thors.
Wields twin daggers in battle before swearing off violence.
Followed Askeladd's mercenary band for years seeking a fair duel.

name: ALPHONSE
hints: Has a soft spot for stray kittens.
His soul is bound to a giant hollow suit of steel armor.
Frequently mistaken for the 'Fullmetal Alchemist'.

name: KAKASHI
hints: Invented the Lightning Blade (Chidori).
Always late to meetings and reads 'Make-Out Paradise' in public.
Known across nations as the 'Copy Ninja'.

name: MIKASA
hints: An elite soldier of the Survey Corps with superhuman strength.
Wears a red scarf given to her by Eren.
Adopted by the Yeager family after her parents were murdered.

name: LEVI
hints: Captain of the Survey Corps Special Operations Squad.
Obsessively clean and short in stature.
Known as humanity's strongest soldier.

name: SAITAMA
hints: Registered as a Class B hero and is obsessed with bargain sales.
Lost all his hair due to his intense training regimen.
A hero who can defeat any enemy with a single punch.

name: KURAPIKA
hints: Uses chains as his primary weapon and Nen ability.
His eyes turn scarlet when he becomes emotional.
The last survivor of the Kurta clan.

name: FRIEREN
hints: Known for her extreme apathy and love for Zoltraak.
Collects weird grimoires and spells.
An elf mage who outlived her party members.

name: ZENITSU
hints: Uses Thunder Breathing, specifically the first form.
A cowardly demon slayer who only fights when unconscious.
Has a massive crush on Nezuko.

name: INOSUKE
hints: Uses Beast Breathing.
Wears a boar's head mask and uses two jagged swords.
Raised by boars in the mountains.

name: ITACHI
hints: Wears a ring with the kanji for 'Vermilion' and uses crow clones.
Massacred his clan to protect his younger brother Sasuke.
A prodigy of the Konoha military police clan who joined the Akatsuki.

name: ARMIN
hints: Inherited the Colossal Titan.
Known for his strategic intellect rather than combat skills.
Childhood friend of Eren and Mikasa.

name: HANGE
hints: Becomes the 14th commander of the Survey Corps.
Often wears goggles and has messy hair.
Obsessed with researching Titans.

name: SHANKS
hints: Known for his incredible Haki.
Lost his left arm saving Luffy.
Captain of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Four Emperors.

name: SANJI
hints: Always swoons over beautiful women.
Refuses to use his hands in battle to protect them for cooking.
The Straw Hats' cook and a master of kicks.

name: ZORO
hints: Wields the Enma sword.
Has no sense of direction and often gets lost.
A master swordsman who uses the Three-Sword Style.

name: NAMI
hints: Uses a staff to control the weather.
A skilled thief and cartographer.
The Straw Hats' navigator.

name: POWER
hints: Has horns and a messy appearance.
Loves cats and fighting.
The Blood Fiend.

name: MAKIMA
hints: Has a distinct red-haired look and wears suits.
Controls people through her mysterious powers.
A high-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter.

name: GOJO
hints: Wears a blindfold to protect others from his eyes.
Mentor to Yuji Itadori.
The strongest sorcerer.

name: YUJI
hints: Uses Divergent Fist and Black Flash.
Host of the King of Curses.
Swallowed a cursed object to save his friends.

name: NOBARA
hints: Extremely confident and fashionable.
Uses a hammer and nails as her weapons.
A first-year at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

name: BAKUGO
hints: Chose the hero name 'Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight'.
Ignites nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms.
Childhood rival of Izuku Midoriya.

name: DEKU
hints: Writes notes on every hero he meets.
Cries very easily.
Born quirkless but inherited One For All.

name: SHOTO
hints: Can use both fire and ice.
Has heterochromia and a scar on his left eye.
Son of the number two hero, Endeavor.

name: MEGUMI
hints: Inherited the prized Ten Shadows Technique.
Uses shadow puppets to summon shikigami.
A first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

name: HISOKA
hints: Often seen with a star and teardrop painted on his face.
Uses Bungee Gum, which has the properties of both rubber and gum.
A mysterious magician with a love for fighting strong opponents.

name: FEITAN
hints: His Nen ability is Pain Packer, which turns pain into heat.
Specializes in torture and uses a sword.
A member of the Phantom Troupe.

name: MERUEM
hints: Develops a bond with the blind girl Komugi.
Extremely powerful and ruthless.
The King of the Chimera Ants.

name: NEZUKO
hints: Can use Blood Demon Art: Exploding Blood.
Wears a bamboo muzzle to stop herself from biting people.
Turned into a demon by Muzan.

name: YOR
hints: Wields twin stilettos hidden in her dress.
Pretends to be a housewife in a fake marriage.
An assassin known as the Thorn Princess.

name: ANYA
hints: Has pink hair and wears a black hairband.
Loves watching the anime 'Spy Wars'.
A telepath adopted by Loid Forger.

name: LOID
hints: Adopts a telepathic daughter and marries an assassin.
Needs to form a fake family for Operation Strix.
A master spy codenamed Twilight.

name: HIMMEL
hints: Frieren only realized her feelings for him after his death.
Was known for his charm and heroism.
The hero who defeated the Demon King.

name: AIZEN
hints: Uses Kyoka Suigetsu to control all five senses.
Betrayed the Soul Society and created his own Arrancar army.
A former captain of the 5th Division.

name: ICHIGO
hints: Wields a giant cleaver-like Zanpakuto.
A substitute Soul Reaper with orange hair.
Has a Hollow mask and uses Getsuga Tensho.

name: RENGOKU
hints: Uses Flame Breathing.
Has very distinctive eyebrows and bright yellow hair.
The Flame Hashira who fought Akaza.

name: MAKISE
hints: A genius neuroscience researcher.
Often teased for being a 'tsundere'.
Helped Okabe build the Phone Microwave.
